svg.title: Animated code editor style profile banner for Lekhashree B, Full-Stack and AI/ML Engineer, showing scrolling project icons and a typed profile.py file
svg.desc: A dark code editor mockup with a header naming Lekhashree B as a Full-Stack and AI/ML Engineer, a vertically scrolling sidebar of project icons for Clario, CrimeTrace, SafeGuard, Aurora and IoT, next to a code panel typing out her role, IEEE paper presentation, tech stack and achievements, with a blinking cursor.
